notes.title: Cats in Cozy Rooms is out now!
notes.content: [p]We’re excited to announce that [b]Cats in Cozy Rooms[/b] is officially out! 🐱✨[/p][p]You can now [b]try the free demo[/b] or [b]buy the full version[/b], available [b]right now[/b]![/p][p]Design, decorate, and relax with your feline friends in the coziest rooms imaginable.[/p][p]We’d love to see your creations—[b]share your decorated rooms[/b] with us![/p][p]Thank you for your support and happy decorating! 🛋️🎨🐾[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416500/6c89f64c4fe792bd053b575efb4dc5fc12f1fc9c.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Cats in Cozy Rooms is LIVE
Welcome to Cats in Cozy Rooms
notes.content:
Welcome to "Cats in Cozy Rooms" Design Journey! 1#

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416500/5dedd7866ab04fbdf9a662c9695887e5eba627ee.jpg[/img]

Hello, everyone! We're excited to introduce our cozy decorating game, where you step into the paws of a cat designer, helping other cats create their dream rooms!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416500/b9bec11b429671529646af425ac130719c80a9c6.jpg[/img]

In this isometric world, you’ll mix and match furniture from different styles—right now, you can play with minimalist and rustic designs. Plus, you can decorate with unique themes like music and botanic! And this is just the beginning—many more styles and themes are on the way!

Here are some concept art we did along the way! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416500/fc3e4b6ab52534ea6829e7d86e9d97aa73193eb6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416500/74fd7d3ec985ec8180197dd7ed11e3cbb152c0e6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416500/fd889abbf042438100035a5f3c80a2b3f5466a73.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416500/59479ffe94a171561cad31907d2c41b8cd13ab7e.jpg[/img]

Our Demo version should be out now! Go play!
